# Aim

Plot the 3D configuration of the mouse Sox2 locus using Region Capture
Micro-C data (GSM6281849) from Goel et al.

The RCMC data are mapped to mm39. Most genomic annotations used in our
analyses are in mm10.

Therefore:

1. genomic annotations are defined in mm10;
2. annotations are lifted from mm10 to mm39 for plotting;
3. the GENOVA pyramid itself is plotted in mm39;
4. the displayed genomic x-axis is converted back to mm10 coordinates.

Brosh/Maurano and Ribeiro dos Santos annotations are included to show the
Sox2 proximal regulatory region and the distal DHS/CTCF architecture.

```{r load_libraries}
  sapply(
    vect,
    function(X) {
      paste(
        str_split(X, sep)[[1]][N1:N2],
        collapse = sep
      )
    },
    USE.NAMES = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r A_RCMC_pyramid_annotated, fig.width = 7.2, fig.height = 3}
#plotting range on mm39
plot_range_hiC = c(34.65E6,
                   34.9E6)

#annotations
annotation_gr_mm10 = c(Sox2_gene, enhancer)
names(annotation_gr_mm10) = c("Sox2", "SCR")

annotation_gr_mm39 = unlist(liftOver(annotation_gr_mm10, chain_mm10_to_mm39))
bed_tib_mm39 = as_tibble(annotation_gr_mm39)

# CTCF annotation
CTCF_ROI_mm10 = subsetByOverlaps(CTCF_mm10.chr3_extra, GRanges(seqnames = "chr3", IRanges(start = 30E6, end = 40E6)))
CTCF_ROI_mm39 = unlist(liftOver(CTCF_ROI_mm10, chain_mm10_to_mm39))

  exp = RCMC_1kb,
  chrom = "chr3",
  colour = c(0, 1500),

p + 
  geom_rect(data = bed_tib_mm39, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end), ymin = -30E3, ymax = -10E3) +
```

# Load Brosh - Maurano annotations
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# Original Brosh / Maurano payload coordinates
# =========================================================================

Brosh_coordinates <- read_tsv(
  "/DATA/projects/CTCF_Sox2/external_datasets/annotations_Brosh_paper/Maurano_genomic_coordinates_excel.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


Brosh_table_S4 <- read_tsv(
  "/DATA/projects/CTCF_Sox2/external_datasets/annotations_Brosh_paper/Maurano_TableS4_excel.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# =========================================================================
# Ribeiro dos Santos DHS / Sox2 annotation table
# PMID 41125441
# Coordinates are mm10
# =========================================================================

Ribeiro_Brosh_DHS_annotations <- read_tsv(
  "/DATA/projects/CTCF_Sox2/external_datasets/annotations_Brosh_paper/Ribeiro_Dos_Santos_PMID_41125441_Supplemental_Table_S1.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean Brosh Table S4 column names
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Brosh_table_S4 <- Brosh_table_S4 %>%
  rename(
    Payload_ID = `Payload ID`,
    Clone_ID = `Clone ID`,
    Sox2_CAST = `Sox2 (CAST)`,
    Sox2_BL6 = `Sox2 (BL6)`,
    Fold_change = `Fold change`
  )


Brosh_coordinates <- Brosh_coordinates %>%
  rename(
    chrom = `#chrom`
  )


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean Ribeiro table
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ribeiro_Brosh_DHS_annotations <- Ribeiro_Brosh_DHS_annotations %>%
  rename(
    chrom = `#Chrom`,
    chromStart = ChromStart,
    chromEnd = ChromEnd,
    name = Name
  )


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Merge Brosh payload coordinates with Table S4 annotation
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Brosh_table_S4_sel <- Brosh_table_S4 %>%
  select(
    Groups,
    Payload_ID,
    Label
  ) %>%
  rename(
    name = Payload_ID
  ) %>%
  distinct()


Brosh_coordinates_merged <- Brosh_coordinates %>%
  left_join(
    Brosh_table_S4_sel,
    by = "name"
  )


# Inspect Ribeiro annotations
Ribeiro_Brosh_DHS_annotations
```

## Define mm10 plotting range and convert it to mm39
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# IMPORTANT:
#
# We define the region we want to SEE in mm10.
#
# GENOVA needs the corresponding mm39 coordinates because the Micro-C
# contact matrix itself is mm39.
# =========================================================================


plot_range_mm10 <- c(
  34.59E6,
  34.83E6
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lift the two boundaries mm10 -> mm39
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_range_points_mm10 <- GRanges(
  seqnames = rep(
    "chr3",
    2
  ),
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = plot_range_mm10,
    end = plot_range_mm10
  )
)


plot_range_lifted <- liftOver(
  plot_range_points_mm10,
  chain_mm10_to_mm39
)


# Each boundary should map exactly once
if (any(lengths(plot_range_lifted) != 1)) {
  stop(
    "One or both plotting-range boundaries did not map uniquely from mm10 to mm39."
  )
}


plot_range_mm39 <- start(
  unlist(
    plot_range_lifted,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


plot_range_mm39 <- sort(
  plot_range_mm39
)


message(
  "mm10 plotting range: ",
  paste(plot_range_mm10, collapse = " - ")
)

message(
  "mm39 plotting range: ",
  paste(plot_range_mm39, collapse = " - ")
)

```

## Prepare mm10 x-axis lables for the mm39 plot
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# Generate axis tick positions in mm10
#
# The ticks are then lifted to mm39 so that their position matches the
# mm39 contact matrix.
#
# Their LABELS remain the original mm10 coordinates.
# =========================================================================


axis_tick_spacing <- 50E3


axis_breaks_mm10 <- seq(
  ceiling(
    plot_range_mm10[1] / axis_tick_spacing
  ) * axis_tick_spacing,

  floor(
    plot_range_mm10[2] / axis_tick_spacing
  ) * axis_tick_spacing,

  by = axis_tick_spacing
)


axis_ticks_gr_mm10 <- GRanges(
  seqnames = rep(
    "chr3",
    length(axis_breaks_mm10)
  ),
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = axis_breaks_mm10,
    end = axis_breaks_mm10
  )
)


axis_ticks_lifted <- liftOver(
  axis_ticks_gr_mm10,
  chain_mm10_to_mm39
)


# Keep only uniquely mapped tick positions
valid_axis_ticks <- lengths(
  axis_ticks_lifted
) == 1


axis_breaks_mm39 <- start(
  unlist(
    axis_ticks_lifted[valid_axis_ticks],
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)


axis_labels_mm10 <- sprintf(
  "%.2f",
  axis_breaks_mm10[valid_axis_ticks] / 1E6
)


# Check correspondence
axis_conversion_table <- tibble(
  mm10 = axis_breaks_mm10[valid_axis_ticks],
  mm39 = axis_breaks_mm39,
  label = axis_labels_mm10
)

axis_conversion_table

```

## Lift CTCF sites
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# Restrict CTCF sites to the actual mm10 plotting region BEFORE liftover.
#
# This prevents off-panel annotations from expanding/squishing the plot.
# =========================================================================


plot_region_gr_mm10 <- GRanges(
  seqnames = "chr3",
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = plot_range_mm10[1],
    end = plot_range_mm10[2]
  )
)


CTCF_ROI_mm10 <- subsetByOverlaps(
  CTCF_mm10.chr3_extra,
  plot_region_gr_mm10
)


CTCF_ROI_mm39 <- unlist(
  liftOver(
    CTCF_ROI_mm10,
    chain_mm10_to_mm39
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)


CTCF_ROI_mm39_tib <- as_tibble(
  CTCF_ROI_mm39
)

```

## Prepare Ribeiro / Brosh regulatory annotaions
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# Selected annotations:
#
# Sox2Proximal = broad proximal regulatory region
# Sox2Promoter = promoter interval
#
# DHS19-27 and CTCF25/28 = individually mapped distal regulatory elements
#
# Sox2LCR is not plotted here because we already display our SCR interval
# separately and the individual distal elements provide more information.
# =========================================================================


Ribeiro_annotations_to_plot <- c(
  "Sox2Proximal",
  "Sox2Promoter",
  "Sox2DHS19",
  "Sox2DHS20",
  "Sox2DHS21",
  "Sox2DHS22",
  "Sox2DHS23",
  "Sox2DHS24",
  "Sox2CTCF25",
  "Sox2DHS26",
  "Sox2DHS27",
  "Sox2CTCF28"
)


Ribeiro_plot_mm10 <- Ribeiro_Brosh_DHS_annotations %>%
  filter(
    name %in% Ribeiro_annotations_to_plot
  )


# Make sure all requested annotations were found
missing_Ribeiro_annotations <- setdiff(
  Ribeiro_annotations_to_plot,
  Ribeiro_plot_mm10$name
)


if (length(missing_Ribeiro_annotations) > 0) {
  warning(
    "Missing Ribeiro annotations: ",
    paste(
      missing_Ribeiro_annotations,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert mm10 table -> GRanges
#
# ChromStart / ChromEnd are treated as BED-style coordinates.
# starts.in.df.are.0based = TRUE converts the start appropriately.
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ribeiro_gr_mm10 <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  Ribeiro_plot_mm10,
  seqnames.field = "chrom",
  start.field = "chromStart",
  end.field = "chromEnd",
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE,
  starts.in.df.are.0based = TRUE
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Liftover mm10 -> mm39
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ribeiro_lifted <- liftOver(
  Ribeiro_gr_mm10,
  chain_mm10_to_mm39
)


if (any(lengths(Ribeiro_lifted) == 0)) {
  warning(
    "One or more Ribeiro annotations failed liftover."
  )
}


if (any(lengths(Ribeiro_lifted) > 1)) {
  warning(
    "One or more Ribeiro annotations mapped to multiple mm39 intervals."
  )
}


Ribeiro_gr_mm39 <- unlist(
  Ribeiro_lifted,
  use.names = FALSE
)


Ribeiro_tib_mm39 <- as_tibble(
  Ribeiro_gr_mm39
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Separate broad proximal region / promoter / distal elements
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ribeiro_proximal_mm39 <- Ribeiro_tib_mm39 %>%
  filter(
    name == "Sox2Proximal"
  )


Ribeiro_promoter_mm39 <- Ribeiro_tib_mm39 %>%
  filter(
    name == "Sox2Promoter"
  )


Ribeiro_distal_mm39 <- Ribeiro_tib_mm39 %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(
      name,
      "^Sox2(DHS|CTCF)"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_label = str_remove(
      name,
      "^Sox2"
    )
  )


# Inspect final lifted annotations
Ribeiro_tib_mm39 %>%
  select(
    seqnames,
    start,
    end,
    name,
    Reference
  )

```

## Plot annotated region capture micro-C
```{r}

# =========================================================================
# Contact matrix = mm39
# Displayed genomic coordinates = mm10
# =========================================================================


p <- GENOVA::pyramid(
  exp = RCMC_1kb,
  chrom = "chr3",
  colour = c(
    0,
    1500
  ),
  start = plot_range_mm39[1],
  end = plot_range_mm39[2]
)


p_annotated <- p +


  # =======================================================================
  # Sox2 gene and SCR
  # =======================================================================

  geom_rect(
    data = bed_tib_mm39,
    aes(
      xmin = start,
      xmax = end
    ),
    ymin = -30E3,
    ymax = -15E3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey50"
  ) +


  geom_text(
    data = bed_tib_mm39,
    aes(
      x = (start + end) / 2,
      y = -22.5E3,
      label = feature
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.8
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # CTCF sites
  # =======================================================================

  geom_segment(
    data = CTCF_ROI_mm39_tib,
    aes(
      x = start,
      xend = start,
      colour = strand
    ),
    y = -30E3,
    yend = -15E3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +


  # Vertical guides through Micro-C plot
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = start(
      CTCF_ROI_mm39
    ),
    colour = "darkgrey",
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # Launch pads
  # =======================================================================

  geom_vline(
    data = LP_tib_mm39,
    aes(
      xintercept = start
    ),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +


  geom_text(
    data = LP_tib_mm39,
    aes(
      x = start,
      y = -34E3,
      label = feature
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    size = 2.5
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # Ribeiro / Brosh proximal regulatory region
  # =======================================================================

  geom_rect(
    data = Ribeiro_proximal_mm39,
    aes(
      xmin = start,
      xmax = end
    ),
    ymin = -52E3,
    ymax = -42E3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey80"
  ) +


  geom_text(
    data = Ribeiro_proximal_mm39,
    aes(
      x = (start + end) / 2,
      y = -47E3
    ),
    label = "Sox2 proximal region",
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.5
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # Ribeiro / Brosh promoter annotation
  # Drawn inside the proximal-region track
  # =======================================================================

  geom_rect(
    data = Ribeiro_promoter_mm39,
    aes(
      xmin = start,
      xmax = end
    ),
    ymin = -52E3,
    ymax = -42E3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey35"
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # Individually annotated distal DHS / CTCF elements
  # =======================================================================

  geom_rect(
    data = Ribeiro_distal_mm39,
    aes(
      xmin = start,
      xmax = end
    ),
    ymin = -68E3,
    ymax = -58E3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey60"
  ) +


  geom_text(
    data = Ribeiro_distal_mm39,
    aes(
      x = (start + end) / 2,
      y = -70E3,
      label = plot_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 1,
    size = 2.1
  ) +


  # =======================================================================
  # X AXIS
  #
  # Positions are mm39,
  # labels are the corresponding original mm10 coordinates.
  #
  # limits + zero expansion prevent the axis from extending beyond the
  # Micro-C panel and prevent the plot from being horizontally squished.
  # =======================================================================

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axis_breaks_mm39,
    labels = axis_labels_mm10,
    limits = plot_range_mm39,
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0,
        0
      )
    ),
    name = "Genomic coordinate (Mb, mm10)"
  ) +


  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

p_annotated
```
